_comment: THIS FILE IS ONLY AN EXAMPLE. The bot never reads it. The list the bot really uses is ignore_list.json. Copy the blocks you want from here into that file.
_how_it_works: The list has one block per page. Each block says which pages it applies to and what the bot must not change on them.
_page: The page. Write a page title or a full https://bluearchive.wiki/wiki/... link. A slash at the end is fine.
_single_page: true = the block applies to the page itself.
_range: [first, last] = the block applies to the numbered subpages from Page/first to Page/last, for example [1, 9] means Page/1 to Page/9.
_all_subpages: true = the block applies to every page under the page, however deep (Page/1, Page/12, Page/2/1 and so on). This already includes everything a range would cover.
_ignore: What the bot must not change. "everything" (the default) = the bot leaves the whole page alone. A list of template names = the bot keeps those templates exactly as they are on the wiki, but still updates everything else on the page.
_defaults: If you give none of single_page, range or all_subpages, the block applies to the page itself.
_examples: The pages below are real wiki pages. They are only there to show the format.

_comment: Example 1: the bot never touches this one page. Nothing on it is updated.

Example 2: on Story/1 to Story/9 and on every other page under Story (the main page that holds them is not included), the bot keeps the templates Story/StoryTop and Story/StoryBottom as they are on the wiki. It still updates the rest of those pages.

Example 3: the bot never touches Story/1 to Story/5 (the numbered pages under Steel_Continent_Assault/Story). It still updates Story/6 and later, and the main Steel_Continent_Assault/Story page that holds them.

Example 4: the same as Example 3, but it also ignores the main page that holds the numbered pages. single_page: true is what adds the main page. Here the bot never touches the main Kivotos_Unsolved_Mysteries Story page, or Story/1 to Story/5 under it. Story/6 and later are still updated.
Example 5: the bot never touches this page or any page under it.
Example 6: on this one page, the bot keeps only the template Story/StoryBottom as it is on the wiki. All other templates and text on the page are still overwritten.
